description: This file defines the LocalizationController class within the OrangeHRM admin plugin, responsible for preparing localization settings (languages and date formats) for rendering in a Vue.js component during web requests.

classes.name: LocalizationController
classes.description: Controller managing localization settings, extending AbstractVueController to prepare localization data for frontend components.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the localization configuration component with supported languages and date formats, sets it for rendering.
